notes:
# DT Effects 1.0.15

**Visualizers**
- **DT Tremolo:** fixed the waveform clipping off the bottom at higher Depth — the whole
  wave now stays cleanly below the rate readout at any depth, with a subtle,
  epilepsy-safe on-beat glow.
- **DT Phaser:** brand-new "Notch Field" display — moving notches drift across a soft
  spectrum field, clean and calm (no motion sickness), tracking the real sweep rate.
- **DT Flanger:** fixed the high-end "scrunch" — the top of the sweep stays clear in motion.

**Learn / dynamics**
- **DT Comp & DT MB:** more accurate **Learn** (loudness-weighted analysis, slightly
  longer learn window). DT MB **M/S/B** buttons now stay centered under each band as you
  drag the crossovers, and a stray glyph on the Learn button is fixed.

**Layout & fixes**
- **DT EQ & DT Verb:** band dials and readouts are centered and no longer crowd the band
  buttons or the band name.
- **DT Auto Filter:** widened so the full "Unipolar"/"Bipolar" label is visible.
- **DT Trance Gate:** custom step counts (e.g. 7 or 11) now loop cleanly instead of
  restarting mid-cycle; 4/8/16/32 still lock to the downbeat.
- **DT Exciter:** hardened against a rare runaway "feedback"-like roar when many bands
  are driven hard (and against bad host samples) — no change to the normal sound.
- Broader "steer the eye" layout polish across the DT standalone effects.
